data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

FJ Capital Management’s most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in CBNA, AVBC, and HWBK.

On September 4, 2026, HWBK completed an acquisition or disposition of assets in an 8-K Item 2.01 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/893847/000089384726000091/hwbk-20260903.htm).

I publish a free weekly issue using public records only and can offer a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger
